options.name: Two Synaptic Obliterators and Two Transdimensional Projectors

ghost-ark.name: Ghost Ark
ghost-ark.transport: This unit can transport up to 10 <DYNASTY> INFANTRY CHARACTER or <DYNASTY> NECRON WARRIORS models. It cannot transport DESTROYER LORD models.

ctan-shard-of-the-void-dragon.name: C'tan Shard of the Void Dragon
keywords: C'TAN SHARD OF THE VOID DRAGON

profiles.name: C'tan Shard of the Void Dragon

spear-of-the-void-dragon-shooting.name: Spear of the Void Dragon (Shooting)
spear-of-the-void-dragon-shooting.text:
Re-roll wound rolls for attacks made with this weapon that target enemy VEHICLE units.

Each time an attack is made with this weapon, if a hit is scored, draw a straight line between the closest point of this model's base and that of the closest model in the target unit. Make one wound roll against the target unit, and each other unit this line passes over.

spear-of-the-void-dragon-melee-and-canop.name: Spear of the Void Dragon (Melee) and Canoptek Tail Blades
spear-of-the-void-dragon-melee-and-canop.text: Re-roll wound rolls for attacks made with this weapon that target enemy VEHICLE units.

living-metal.name: Living Metal
living-metal.text: At the start of each turn, roll one D6 for each damage marker next to each NECRONS unit in this Detachment; for each roll of 5+ remove one damage marker from the unit being rolled for.

grand-illusion.name: Grand Illusion
grand-illusion.text: When you select this unit's Detachment to carry out an order, before any units in that Detachment make any actions for that order, you can replace that Detachment's order with Advance, Aimed Fire or Assault.

portal-of-exile.name: Portal of Exile
portal-of-exile.text: After this unit ends a Move action choose one enemy unit within 1" of this unit and roll one D6; on a 5+, place a blast marker next to that unit.

eternity-gate.name: Eternity Gate
eternity-gate.text: During deployment, you can set up any number of <DYNASTY> INFANTRY units on their tomb world. Such a unit is considered to be set up in Tactical Reserves. When a unit that was set up on its tomb world arrives as reinforcements, you must select one friendly <DYNASTY> MONOLITH or <DYNASTY> NIGHT SCYTHE unit for it to deploy from; set up the arriving unit within 6" of the selected unit. If it is impossible to do so, you cannot set up that unit this turn. Each MONOLITH and NIGHT SCYTHE unit can only be deployed from once per turn. No more than half the total number of units in your army can be set up in Tactical Reserves.

my-will-be-done-ccb.name: My Will be Done (CCB)
my-will-be-done-ccb.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly LIGHT <DYNASTY> units whilst they are within 12" of this unit.

wave-of-command.name: Wave of Command
wave-of-command.text: If a LIGHT <DYNASTY> unit starts a Move action within 6" of any friendly units with this ability, add 3" to that unit’s Move characteristic for that action.

hyper-logical-strategist.name: Hyper-logical Strategist
hyper-logical-strategist.text: At the start of the Generate Command Assets step, if this unit is a WARLORD and is on the battlefield, you generate one extra Command Asset.

lord-of-the-storm.name: Lord of the Storm
lord-of-the-storm.text: Once per battle, at the start of the Action phase, you can select one point on the battlefield within 24" of this unit and place one marker (e.g. a coin) on that point. At the end of that Action phase, roll one D12 for each unit within 6" of that marker before removing that marker from the battlefield; on a 4-8 place one blast marker next to the unit being rolled for, and on a 9-12 place two blast markers next to the unit being rolled for.

technomancer-sautekh.name: Technomancer (Sautekh)
technomancer-sautekh.text: Friendly SAUTEKH units have the Ignore Damage (6+) ability whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

the-stars-are-right.name: The Stars are Right
the-stars-are-right.text: At the start of the turn, if this unit is not empowered, roll one D6. If the result is less than the current turn number, this unit becomes empowered; until the end of the battle, use the Orikan Empowered profile for this unit.

counter-tactics.name: Counter Tactics
counter-tactics.text: At the start of the Action phase, you can select one enemy CHARACTER unit within 24" of this unit. Until the start of the next turn, any aura abilities that unit has have no effect.

the-lords-will-sautekh.name: The Lord's Will (Sautekh)
the-lords-will-sautekh.text: Re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly LIGHT SAUTEKH units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

the-vargards-duty.name: The Vargard's Duty
the-vargards-duty.text: At the start of the Damage phase, you can select one friendly NEMESOR ZAHNDREKH unit that has at least one blast marker next to it and is within 6" of this unit. Remove one blast marker from that unit and place it next to this unit.

technomancer-no-dynasty.name: Technomancer (No Dynasty)
technomancer-no-dynasty.text: Friendly NECRONS units have the Ignore Damage (6+) ability whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

mechanical-augmentations.name: Mechanical Augmentations
mechanical-augmentations.text: After this unit makes a Move action, you can select one friendly NECRONS WARRIORS or IMMORTALS unit within 1" of this unit to mechanically augment. Roll a D3 and apply the result from the table below to the chosen unit for the rest of the battle. A unit can only be mechanically augmented once per battle.

augmentation-1.name: Augmentation 1
augmentation-1.text: Improve the SAP characteristic of weapons the unit is equipped with by 1 (e.g. 8+ becomes 7+).

augmentation-2.name: Augmentation 2
augmentation-2.text: Improve the unit’s Save characteristic by 1 (e.g. 5+ becomes 4+).

augmentation-3.name: Augmentation 3
augmentation-3.text: Improve the unit’s Ballistic Skill characteristic by 1 (e.g. 4+ becomes 3+).

empyric-overcharger.name: Empyric Overcharger
empyric-overcharger.text: After this unit makes a Move action, select one enemy PSYKER unit within 12" of it and roll one D12; on a 9+ place one blast marker next to that unit.

atomic-energy-manipulator.name: Atomic Energy Manipulator
atomic-energy-manipulator.text: If this model destroys one of more enemy models with a Melee attack, then at the end of the Fight action it can use it's Mechanical Augmentation ability as if it was the end of it's Move action.

my-will-be-done-no-dynasty.name: My Will be Done (No Dynasty)
my-will-be-done-no-dynasty.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly NECRON INFANTRY units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

lord-of-the-pyrrhian-legions.name: Lord of the Pyrrhian Legions
lord-of-the-pyrrhian-legions.text: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly NECRONS INFANTRY units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

my-will-be-done-nihilakh.name: My Will be Done (Nihilakh)
my-will-be-done-nihilakh.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly LIGHT NIHILAKH units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

surrogate-hosts.name: Surrogate Hosts
surrogate-hosts.text: When this unit is destroyed, after removing it and all the markers next to it from the battlefield, you can select one friendly NECRONS INFANTRY CHARACTER unit on the battlefield. That unit is destroyed, and after removing it and all the markers next to it from the battlefield, place this unit as close as possible to where that unit was located.

my-will-be-done.name: My Will be Done
my-will-be-done.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly LIGHT <DYNASTY> units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

technomancer.name: Technomancer
technomancer.text: Friendly <DYNASTY> units have the Ignore Damage (6+) ability whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

chronometron.name: Chronometron
chronometron.text: Re-roll saving throws of 1 for friendly <DYNASTY> INFANTRY units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

united-in-hatred.name: United in Hatred
united-in-hatred.text: Re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly <DYNASTY> DESTROYER CULT units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

the-lords-will.name: The Lord's Will
the-lords-will.text: Re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly LIGHT <DYNASTY> units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

guardian-protocols.name: Guardian Protocols
guardian-protocols.text: At the start of the Damage phase, you can select one friendly <DYNASTY> LIGHT CHARACTER unit that has at least one blast marker next to it and is within 6" of this unit. Remove up to D3 blast markers from that CHARACTER unit and place them next to this unit.

dispersion-shields.name: Dispersion Shields
dispersion-shields.text: If this unit has Dispersion Shields, it has a Save characteristic of 4+.

gravity-pulse.name: Gravity Pulse
gravity-pulse.text: At the end of the Action phase, roll one D12 for each enemy AIRCRAFT unit within 12" of this unit; on a 9+ place one blast marker next to that unit.

invasion-beams.name: Invasion Beams
invasion-beams.text: During deployment, you can set up any number of <DYNASTY> INFANTRY units on their tomb world. Such a unit is considered to be set up in Tactical Reserves. When a unit that was set up on its tomb world arrives as reinforcements, you must select one friendly <DYNASTY> MONOLITH or <DYNASTY>  NIGHT SCYTHE unit for it to deploy from; set up the arriving unit within 6" of the selected unit. If it is impossible to do so, you cannot set up that unit this turn. Each MONOLITH and NIGHT SCYTHE unit can only be deployed from once per turn. No more than half the total number of units in your army can be set up in Tactical Reserves.

repair-barge.name: Repair Barge
repair-barge.text: After this unit makes a Move action, you can remove one damage marker from a friendly <DYNASTY> NECRON WARRIORS unit embarked aboard it.

a-purpose-unshakable.name: A Purpose Unshakable
a-purpose-unshakable.text: Morale tests taken for this unit are automatically passed.

targeting-relay.name: Targeting Relay
targeting-relay.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made with ranged weapons by other friendly NECRONS units if the target of that attack was also the target of an attack made with a ranged weapon by this unit this turn.

heat-ray.name: Heat Ray
heat-ray.text: When this unit makes a Shoot action, it can shoot with either the Heat Ray (Dispersed) weapon or Heat Ray (Focused) weapon; it cannot shoot with both.

wraith-form.name: Wraith Form
wraith-form.text: This unit can move across models and terrain as if they were not there.

scarab-hive.name: Scarab Hive
scarab-hive.text: At the end of the Action phase, you can replenish one friendly <DYNASTY> SCARABS unit within 6" of this unit. If you do, remove one damage marker from that unit. Each SCARABS unit can only be replenished once per turn.

fabricator-array.name: Fabricator Array
fabricator-array.text: At the end of the Action phase, this unit can attempt to repair one friendly <DYNASTY> VEHICLE unit in base contact with it. If it does, roll one D6; on a 4+ remove one damage marker from that VEHICLE unit. Only one attempt to repair each unit can be made each turn.

cosmic-tyrant.name: Cosmic Tyrant
cosmic-tyrant.text: Once per turn, you can re-roll one hit roll or one wound roll for an attack made by this unit, or you can re-roll one saving throw made for this unit.

death-sphere-bombardment.name: Death Sphere Bombardment
death-sphere-bombardment.text: When this unit finishes making a Move action, select one enemy unit it moved over whilst making that Move action. Roll two D6, subtracting 1 from each result if that unit is a CHARACTER and adding 1 to each result if that unit is HEAVY or SUPER-HEAVY; for each 3+ place one blast marker next to that unit.

sentry-net.name: Sentry Net
sentry-net.text: Each Heavy Support slot in a Detachment allows you to take up to three of this unit in your army, instead of one. Each unit taken for a single Heavy Support slot must be placed at the same time and within 6" of each other unit taken for the same slot the first time they are set up.

my-will-be-done-maynarkh.name: My Will be Done (Maynarkh)
my-will-be-done-maynarkh.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly LIGHT MAYNARKH units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

splinter-of-madness.name: Splinter of Madness
splinter-of-madness.text: You can re-roll wound rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by this unit that target units with a lower Leadership characteristic than this unit.

technomancer-maynarkh.name: Technomancer (Maynarkh)
technomancer-maynarkh.text: Friendly LIGHT MAYNARKH units have the Ignore Damage (6+) ability whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

chonometron-maynarkh.name: Chonometron (Maynarkh)
chonometron-maynarkh.text: Re-roll saving throws of 1 for friendly MAYNARKH INFANTRY units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

eternal-engines.name: Eternal Engines
eternal-engines.text: At the end of the Action phase, this unit can attempt to repair one friendly <DYNASTY> VEHICLE unit in base contact with it. If it does, roll one D6; on a 4+ remove one damage marker from that VEHICLE unit. Only one attempt to repair each unit can be made each turn.

immobile-2.name: Immobile
immobile-2.text: This unit is never Out of Command: an Out of Command marker is never placed next to it. When this unit or a friendly unit makes a Shoot action, it can target enemy units in base contact with this unit.

phase-shift-generator.name: Phase Shift Generator
phase-shift-generator.text: Re-roll saving throws of 1 for friendly <DYNASTY> INFANTRY units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

gauss-annihilator.name: Gauss Annihilator
gauss-annihilator.text: Each time this you make a Shoot action with this unit, this unit shoots with its Tesla Arc and either its Gauss Annihilator (Focused Beam) or Gauss Annihilator (Flux Arc).

ziggurat-deck.name: Ziggurat Deck
ziggurat-deck.text: When setting up your army, if this unit is in your deployment zone, a single friendly <DYNASTY> MONOLITH or <DYNASTY> SENTRY PYLON can dock with the Tomb Ziggurat. If they do so, place the model on the Tomb Ziggurat. Whilst a unit is docked with the Tomb Ziggurat, add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by that unit with ranged weapons. Whilst a unit is docked with the Tomb Ziggurat, it is never Out of Command: an Out of Command marker is never placed next to it.

eternity-gate-tomb-ziggurat.name: Eternity Gate (Tomb Ziggurat)
eternity-gate-tomb-ziggurat.text: During deployment, you can set up any number of <DYNASTY> INFANTRY units on their tomb world. Such a unit is considered to be set up in Tactical Reserves. When a unit that was set up on its tomb world arrives as reinforcements, you must select one friendly <DYNASTY> MONOLITH, <DYNASTY> NIGHT SCYTHE or <DYNASTY> TOMB ZIGGURAT unit for it to deploy from; set up the arriving unit within 6" of the selected unit. If it is impossible to do so, you cannot set up that unit this turn. Each MONOLITH, NIGHT SCYTHE and TOMB ZIGGURAT unit can only be deployed from once per turn. No more than half the total number of units in your army can be set up in Tactical Reserves.

power-crucible.name: Power Crucible
power-crucible.text: Add 1 to saving throws made for NECRONS units whilst they are on a Realm of Battle tile with a friendly Power Crucible unit. Re-roll results of 1 for the Living Metal Faction ability for NECRONS units whilst they are on a Realm of Battle tile with a friendly Power Crucible unit.

adaptive-strategy.name: Adaptive Strategy
adaptive-strategy.text: Friendly Light <Dynasty> units can still make a shoot action in a turn in which they fell back whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

relentless-march.name: Relentless March
relentless-march.text:
If a Light <Dynasty> unit starts a Move action within 6" of any friendly
units with this ability, add 1" to that unit’s Move characteristic for that action.

rites-of-reanimation.name: Rites of Reanimation
rites-of-reanimation.text: Friendly <DYNASTY> units have the Ignore Damage (6+) ability whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

canoptek-cloak.name: Canoptek Cloak
canoptek-cloak.text:
The bearer has a move characteristic of 10" and the FLY keyword (already reflected in profile).
In addition, at the end of the Action phase, this unit can repair one friendly <Dynasty> unit in base contact with it. Remove one damage marker from that unit. Only one attempt to repair each unit can be made each turn.

canoptek-control-node.name: Canoptek Control Node
canoptek-control-node.text: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly <DYNASTY> CANOPTEK units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

harbinger-of-despair.name: Harbinger of Despair
harbinger-of-despair.text:
Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.
Subtract 1" from the movement characteristic of enemy units that start a move action within 6" of this unit.

nightmare-shroud.name: Nightmare Shroud
nightmare-shroud.text: Subtract 1 from the leadership characterstic of enemy units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

harbinger-of-destruction.name: Harbinger of Destruction
harbinger-of-destruction.text: After this unit makes a Move action, if this unit did not Fall Back, roll three D6s: for each 4+, place a blast marker next to nearest enemy unit within 24" and visible to this model.

living-lightning.name: Living Lightning
living-lightning.text: After this unit makes a Move action, roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 6" of this model: on a 4+, place a blast marker next to the unit being rolled for.

nanoscarab-reanimation-beam.name: Nanoscarab Reanimation Beam
nanoscarab-reanimation-beam.text: After this unit makes a Move action, you can remove one damage marker from a friendly <DYNASTY> unit within 6" of this unit.

inescapable-threat.name: Inescapable Threat
inescapable-threat.text: You may ignore all hit roll and Ballistic Skill modifers for attacks made by this unit, and the target does not receive the benefits of cover against that attack. In addition, this model may still make a Shoot action if enemy units are in base contact with them, and it may shoot at units that are in base contact with this unit.

multi-threat-eliminator.name: Multi-Threat Eliminator
multi-threat-eliminator.text: When this unit makes a Shoot action, it may target, and resolve attacks against, every eligible enemy LIGHT unit.

systematic-vigour.name: Systematic Vigour
systematic-vigour.text: Whilst this unit is within 6" of any Friendly CRYPTEK units, change this unit's Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill characteristics to 3+ and double it's Attack characteristic.

protectors.name: Protectors
protectors.text: Friendly CRYPTEK units cannot be targeted with ranged weapons whilst they are within 3" of this unit.

evasion-protocol.name: Evasion Protocol
evasion-protocol.text: This unit cannot be targeted with ranged weapons whilst they are within 3" of any Friendly <DYNASTY> DESTROYER CULT units unless it is the closest eligible target.

recall-protocols.name: Recall Protocols
recall-protocols.text: At the beginning of the Damage phase, this unit is destroyed if it is not within 6" of any Friendly <DYNASTY> DESTROYER CULT units.

infused-madness.name: Infused Madness
infused-madness.text: Once per turn, at the start of the Action phase, you can select one friendly <DYNASTY> DESTROYER CULT unit within 3" of this model. If you do, roll one D6: on a 1, place two blast markers next to that unit. Regardless of the result, until the end of the turn, add 1 to that units Attacks characteristic, and add 1 to the SAT and SAP of that unit's melee weapons. Each unit can only be selected for this ability once per turn.

dominion-protocols.name: Dominion Protocols
dominion-protocols.text: Add 2 to the leadership characteristic of friendly <DYNASTY> units whilst they are within 6" of this model

convergence-of-dominion.name: Convergence of Dominion
convergence-of-dominion.text: When this unit is set up, the models do not have to be set up in unit coherence. Instead, each model must be set up wholly within 12" of one other model from its unit. From that point on, each model in this unit is treated as a separate unit (each with 2 wounds).

translocation-protocols.name: Translocation Protocols
translocation-protocols.text:
While there are any STARSTELE units from your army on the battlefield, CRYPTEK units in your army gain the following ability:
'Activate Translocation Protocols: After this unit makes a move action, choose a friendly STARSTELE unit that is within 3" of this remove it from the battlefield. During the next "Set Up Reinforcements" phase, set that STARSTELE unit back up on the battlefield, anywhere that is more than 9" away from any enemy models. If the battle ends and that unit is not on the batttlefied, it is destroyed.'

dynastic-command-node.name: Dynastic Command Node
dynastic-command-node.text: When this model is set up, choose an aura ability from a friendly <DYNASTY> OVERLORD, LORD, SKORPEKH LORD, LOKHUST LORD, ROYAL WARDEN, or CRYPTEK model in your army. This model has a copy of that ability.

hyperphase-reap-blades.name: Hyperphase Reap-blades
hyperphase-reap-blades.text: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack with its Hyperphase Blades and Ophydian Claws, an unmodified hit roll of 6 scores 1 additional hit.

whipcoil-bodies.name: Whipcoil Bodies
whipcoil-bodies.text: Each time a melee attack is made against this unit, subtract 1 from that attack's hit roll.

sentinel-construct.name: Sentinel Construct
sentinel-construct.text: If this unit's Detachment is carrying out an Aimed Fire order, then until the end of the turn, this unit can still make a Shoot action if enemy units are in base contact with them, and they can target enemy units in base contact with friendly NECRON units from this detachment. However, if it does either, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by those units when resolving those attacks.

matter-absorption.name: Matter Absorption
matter-absorption.text: When an attack made by this model adds a blast marker to an enemy VEHICLE unit, roll a d12. On a 9+ remove one blast marker from this unit.

phaeron-of-the-stars.name: Phaeron of the Stars
phaeron-of-the-stars.text: Re-roll hit rolls for ranged attacks made by friendly NECRONS units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

obeisance-generators.name: Obeisance Generators
obeisance-generators.text: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by enemy units that target this unit.

phaeron-of-the-blades.name: Phaeron of the Blades
phaeron-of-the-blades.text: Re-roll wound rolls for melee attacks made by friendly NECRONS units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

relentless-march-2.name: Relentless March
relentless-march-2.text: If a NECRONS unit starts a Move action within 6" of any friendly units with this ability, add 1" to that unit’s Move characteristic for that action.

my-will-be-done-szarekh.name: My Will Be Done (Szarekh)
my-will-be-done-szarekh.text:
Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly NECRONS units whilst they are within 9" of this unit. 
Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of friendly NECRONS units whilst they are within 9" of this unit.

voice-of-the-triarch.name: Voice of the Triarch
voice-of-the-triarch.text: Once per battle, when you select a Detachment to carry out an order, before any units in that Detachment make any actions for that order, you can replace that Detachment’s order with Advance, Aimed Fire or Assault.

triarchal-menhir.name: Triarchal Menhir
triarchal-menhir.text: This unit does not count as a CHARACTER for the purposes of the Sniper keyword whilst it is not critically damaged.

the-silent-king.name: The Silent King
the-silent-king.text: Szarekh must be your Warmaster. If this unit is your Warmaster, you receive 3 addional Command Points at the beginning of the game.

preservative-auto-torpor.name: Preservative Auto-torpor
preservative-auto-torpor.text:
Whilst this unit is Critically Damaged, it cannot make attacks with its Staff of Stars or Annihilator Beams and loses the Phaeron of the Stars ability.

Whilst this unit has 1 wound remaining, it cannot make attacks with its Scythe of Dust and loses the Phaeron of the Blades ability.

my-will-be-done-sautekh.name: My Will be Done (Sautekh)
my-will-be-done-sautekh.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly LIGHT SAUTEKH units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

hardwired-hatred.name: Hardwired Hatred
hardwired-hatred.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by this unit.

enslaved-star-god.name: Enslaved Star God
enslaved-star-god.text: This unit cannot be a WARLORD.

immune-to-natural-law.name: Immune to Natural Law
immune-to-natural-law.text: Roll D12s when making saving throws for this unit, irrespective of the size of the blast markers next to it.

tomb-citadel.name: Tomb Citadel
tomb-citadel.text: This unit can only be included in a Fortification Network Detachment that includes 1 <DYNASTY> Power Crucible unit, 1 <DYNASTY> Tomb Ziggurat unit and 2 <DYNASTY> Gun Emplacement units. Both Gun Emplacement units occupy a single Fortification slot, and the Tomb Ziggurat begins the battle as the Commander of its Detachment.

realm-of-battle.name: Realm of Battle
realm-of-battle.text: This unit is a feature of a Realm of Battle tile, and as such forms part of the battlefield. Once the tile has been placed, this unit it treated as an Obstacle and is not considered to be a unit for any rules purposes until the first turn begins. When this unit is destroyed it is not removed from the battlefield: instead it is treated as a Defensible Terrain feature and is not considered to be a unit for any rules purposes.
